decisions.reason: As a flagship product closely aligned with the firm's move toward design-led, integrated shower drainage, it would usually be retained unless several years of results clearly fell below aspiration levels.

The integrated-slope shower element fits the firm's solution-family logic for modern bathrooms and renovations, so management would likely continue it as long as it contributes acceptably within the broader system offering.

This backflow-protected basement drain is more niche than the core shower lines, but its distinct functional use and fit with the firm's drainage know-how make continued retention plausible while demand remains adequate.

Compared with the other launches, the air-admittance valve is the most peripheral to the firm's strategic shower-drainage focus, so if its performance has remained modest management would reallocate resources to stronger core products and new development.
